# {2}{R}: Target creature can't block this turn.
# The blocker side of Manifold Key's "can't be blocked" form: PREVENT_EFFECT over the declaration of
# blockers whose blocking creature (`filter`) is the ability's target, until end of turn.
cant_block = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostManaColor(color='R', amount=QConst(value=1)), CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)))),
    effect=A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
        'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'event': DeclareBlockersEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET)),
    }),
)
abilities = [cant_block, *compiled]
